# Rahul Goel - Senior Engineering Manager and iOS Platforms

Rahul Goel is a Senior Engineering Manager based in Bengaluru, India. His resume describes 13+ years of software engineering experience, mobile platform work, and leadership of 15 engineers at SonyLIV.

## Professional experience
- SonyLIV: engineering leadership, hiring, career development, technical roadmaps, startup optimization and production reliability. Resume-reported crash-free sessions improved from 97.5% to 99.9%.
- ShareChat/Moj: video streaming infrastructure, intelligent prefetching and multi-tier caching. Resume-reported results include 25% cost reduction, $1M+ annual savings, 99.8% playback success, 30% lower data consumption and 18% FPS improvement.
- Groupon: event analytics with batching, retry logic and offline queueing; Flutter adoption for shared components.
- Paytm: reusable payments SDK and server-driven UI framework.
- Myntra/Jabong: high-availability session management for peak sale traffic.

Company audience and transaction figures describe platform context, not the volume personally processed by a particular SDK or component.
